body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Kkamnyang presented a special charger that can charge maximum 80 batteries in different sizes and kinds at the same time. You can check the battery status and after they are charged fully, a melody comes from the machine. An official at the company said that this special charger is usually purchased by a corporate or a photo agency.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
